recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned intimate portrait of two musicians sharing a moment over a guitar and notebook, overlaid with large, luminous gold-gradient serif typography that interacts with the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Forehead-to-forehead intimacy as the central emotional focus
Contrast between the monochromatic photographic base and the metallic gold text
Textual layering where subjects appear partially behind the large display type
Diagonal compositional line from the guitar neck up through the subjects' faces
coreInvariants: Sepia or desaturated warm-grey photographic palette
Metallic gold gradient texture for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures in the lower two-thirds of the frame, facing each other in profile, scaled to fill the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of contact between the two faces, positioned slightly left of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the guitar in the bottom left, follows the man's arm to the faces, then moves upward to the large gold title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright, overexposed upper background providing a clean canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/charcoal for the photographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white/cream for the overexposed background highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Reflective gold gradient for the primary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast; the gold provides the only perceived 'color' through luminosity.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for drama paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for modern utility.
graphicDevices: Layering masks to tuck text behind foreground hair

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast vertical stress and elegance.
Matches the utilitarian, bold feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, high-contrast photograph of a man with long hair playing an acoustic guitar and a woman with long hair leaning towards him, foreheads touching. They are looking at a notebook. The background is a bright, overexposed white light. The image should have a grainy, cinematic film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase serif text in the top right, using a gold foil gradient. Layer the text so it appears slightly behind the subjects' hair. Add a small, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle in dark charcoal below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the main title metallic gold?
Does the text overlap the subjects naturally?
Is the background sufficiently bright to make the gold pop?

avoid: Default yellow instead of gold gradient

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold gradient has a realistic metallic sheen.
Ensure the hair masking for the text looks integrated and not like a simple cut-out.
Verify the sepia tone is warm and not overly green or muddy.
Confirm the wide tracking on the subtitle is legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, high-contrast intimate portrait with oversized, gold-foil high-contrast serif typography that interacts with the depth of the scene.
